job: Show where someone is in a flow with a fixed order, or how far live work or a record has got.
purpose: An ordered list of steps: finished ones show a check, the current one wears the accent, the rest wait in outline. A wizard sets the position with data-current or setStep(). Live work marks each step running, failed, waiting or skipped, with an owner and one action per step. The tracker variant lays a record's stages across its page and turns vertical below 560px of its own width.
useWhen: A setup or create flow has a fixed order: choose pages, schedule, notify, review.
A vertical list of tasks shows what is done and what comes next.
Work runs in steps on its own and each step reports how it went: a key rotation, a deploy, an import.
One record moves through stages (Proposed, Checked, Approved, Testing, Result) and its page shows where it is.

avoidWhen.when: Views can be visited in any order.
A flow lives in a dialog and needs dots only.
The items are a list people tick off.
The path is a location hierarchy.
Each event has a time and the order of events is the point.
The work is a graph of stages with parallel jobs.

states.name: running
states.how: data-state="running": the accent marker with a turning arc

states.name: failed
states.how: data-state="failed": a cross on the danger tone; the description reads in danger text

states.name: waiting
states.how: data-state="waiting": an hourglass on the warning tone, waiting on the person in fd-step-owner

states.name: skipped
states.how: data-state="skipped": a dashed ring and a dash; setStep keeps it

variants.useWhen: A list with descriptions, as in a getting-started panel.
The stages of one record across the top of its page; vertical below 560px of its own width.

parts.role: The number, check or warning mark.
Who the step waits on: an fd-avatar and a name, under the title.
One small button or link after the body: what to do about the step now.

keyboard.does: On a step button: moves to that step.
